9bd2abcbf584a04f4e5fcfa0b25f2527dc3a4735.sourceText:
| 写法 | 含义 | 注意事项 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `std::make_unique<T>(...)` | 创建独占所有权对象 | C++14 起可用 |
| `std::move(p)` | 把 `unique_ptr` 所有权转出去 | 移动后原指针通常为空 |
| `std::make_shared<T>(...)` | 创建共享所有权对象 | 引用计数有开销 |
| `sp.use_count()` | 查看共享引用计数 | 教学调试可用，业务逻辑不要依赖它 |
| `std::weak_ptr<T>` | 弱引用，不增加引用计数 | 访问前必须 `lock()` |
| `p.reset()` | 释放当前管理的对象 | 对 `shared_ptr` 是减少一次引用计数 |
9bd2abcbf584a04f4e5fcfa0b25f2527dc3a4735.translatedText:
| Syntax | Meaning | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `std::make_unique<T>(...)` | Create an exclusively owned object | C++ Available since 14 |
| `std::move(p)` | Transfer ownership of `unique_ptr` out | After the move, the original pointer is usually null |
| `std::make_shared<T>(...)` | Create a shared\-ownership object | Reference counting has overhead |
| `sp.use_count()` | View the shared reference count | Usable for teaching and debugging; do not rely on it in business logic |
| `std::weak_ptr<T>` | Weak reference; does not increase the reference count | Before access, must `lock()` |
| `p.reset()` | Release the currently managed object | For `shared_ptr`, this decrements the reference count by one |
